Actual overrun above configured reservation is recorded and stops new calls, never hidden or clamped to a fake successful cap. These are admission limits/estimates; do not claim control over provider-side billing. Store accounting may record late cost evidence without authorizing a stale draft commit; document a bounded trusted reconciliation boundary.

5. Cancellation/time budgets: honor the original persisted hard deadline, remaining task cost/call limits across retries, and explicit cancellation. Do not reset a task/day budget for each invocation, recovery, new config hash or generator object. No provider IO after checkpoint/reservation denial, cancellation or stale lease. Async/cooperative transport with explicit timeout contract is acceptable; do not introduce an unbounded blocking Backend.run. The A04 worker owns heartbeat/process custody and CLI kill/reap if a future CLI adapter exists; client cancellation cannot guarantee remote billing stops.
